name: Pull An Egg
desc:
Pull An Egg!
💪 Lift heavy dumbells to get Stronger and to grow Bigger 💪

💡 How to Play:
- Lift heavy weights to get Strong!  💪
- Pull EGGs back to your Base! 🥚
- Don't get caught by the Animal Guards! 👮
- Hatch your Eggs to start earning Money! 🏠
- Upgrade your Dumbells to pull Heavier Eggs! ⚡

Your Animals earn cash OFFLINE! 💤

Like the game and join the group for FREE cash and a Animal! 👍

llm.loop: lift dumbbells for strength -> pull eggs back to base with rope -> avoid animal guards -> hatch eggs -> animals earn cash (offline) -> upgrade
llm.objectives: pull heavier and rarer eggs to grow income
llm.progression: strength, dumbbells, egg tiers, animals, money
llm.instructions: lift weights, pull eggs to base, avoid animal guards, hatch eggs, upgrade dumbbells
unique: eggs dragged by rope instead of carried
llm.thumbnails: noob pulling giant eggs with a rope (lava egg, 67 egg, mystery egg)
llm.complexity_notes: simple open map, rope pulling, guard NPCs, many egg models
